novel_features.name: Forfettario turnover meter
novel_features.description: See exactly how close you are to the forfettario annual turnover limit, with a days-to-limit projection at your current run-rate.
novel_features.rationale: Joins live invoices-stats with the synced fiscal_year.turnover_limit and projects forward — the platform shows a static % bar but never tells you when you'll hit the cap.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Forfettari blow past the cap with no warning. This is the single most-asked question and the platform doesn't answer it.

novel_features.name: Quarterly tax-due projection
novel_features.description: Project IVA, IRPEF, and INPS owed at quarter-end from already-synced invoices, your fiscal regime, and tax rate.
novel_features.rationale: Combines synced invoices + fiscal_year + regime_fiscale locally; the API exposes the inputs but never emits the projection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Cash-flow planning needs a number, not the four web pages you'd have to visit otherwise.

novel_features.name: AR aging report
novel_features.description: Group unpaid invoices into 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, and 90+ day buckets, broken down by customer.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local SQL over the synced invoices table — the platform's web UI offers a flat unpaid list with no aging dimension.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The first thing any commercialista wants on the 1st of the month.

novel_features.name: Client revenue concentration
novel_features.description: Rank customers by year-to-date revenue and flag dangerous concentration (one client > 80% of turnover invites AdE attention for forfettari).
novel_features.rationale: Local Pareto over the synced invoices+customers join — no platform endpoint computes this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Concentration risk is invisible until it isn't; the AdE check is silent.

novel_features.name: VIES bulk validate
novel_features.description: Run /tools/check-vies for every EU customer in your registry and flag invalid or expired VAT IDs.
novel_features.rationale: The platform's web UI validates one VAT at a time; we batch the synced customer list.
novel_features.why_it_matters: An invalid EU VAT on an invoice is an SDI rejection plus a reverse-charge mistake.

novel_features.name: Active vs passive reconcile
novel_features.description: Net out issued invoices against received invoices for any period — quarterly margin in one shot.
novel_features.rationale: The web UI keeps issued and received on separate pages; reconciliation is local-store-only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Margin per quarter without exporting two CSVs and pivoting them by hand.

novel_features.name: F24 calendar export
novel_features.description: Emit upcoming F24 deadlines as an iCal file you can drop into any calendar app.
novel_features.rationale: F24 dates live in the synced f24 + events tables; the platform doesn't export them.
novel_features.why_it_matters: F24 is the most-missed Italian tax deadline. Surface it where you actually look.

novel_features.name: SDI status sweep
novel_features.description: List every invoice you've transmitted to SDI that hasn't been acknowledged after a threshold (default 7 days).
novel_features.rationale: Walks transmitted invoices and pulls /s_d_i_notification per-row, then filters locally — the platform shows status per invoice, not in aggregate.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Stuck SDI transmissions become AdE penalties if you don't catch them.

novel_features.name: Esterometro export
novel_features.description: Generate the AdE-ready CSV for the quarterly esterometro filing from synced foreign-mgmt and EU/extra-EU invoices.
novel_features.rationale: Pulls foreign-mgmt + invoices flagged as foreign and emits the exact CSV shape AdE accepts. Manual today.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Quarterly compliance task; eliminating the manual CSV build is the entire point.

novel_features.name: Stamp duty (bollo) accumulator
novel_features.description: Sum stamp duty owed by quarter from invoices that carry a stamp, ready to cross-check against the AdE pre-fill.
novel_features.rationale: Local sum over invoices.stamp; AdE pre-fills from SDI but discrepancies happen.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The AdE prefill is wrong often enough to want a check column.

novel_features.name: Invoice numbering audit
novel_features.description: Verify your invoices are sequentially numbered per fiscal year as Italian law requires; flag gaps, duplicates, and out-of-order dates.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local query against the synced invoices table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: A missed numbering gap is a real AdE finding during an inspection.

novel_features.name: Portable backup snapshot
novel_features.description: Sync every resource into local SQLite, then dump a portable archive (JSON + CSV + the actual invoice PDFs) you can carry to any other platform.
novel_features.rationale: The platform offers no equivalent. Switching-cost killer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Real-world: every freelancer who's tried to leave one of these platforms knows this is the missing button.

novel_features.name: Safe invoice creation
novel_features.description: Crea una fattura draft con due difese: pre-check del numero (rifiuta duplicati o ritorna l'esistente con --idempotent) e post-error verify (rileva phantom record lasciati da partial-failure 4xx/5xx, opzionalmente li auto-cancella).
novel_features.rationale: Il backend WordPress non avvolge in transazione gli INSERT padre+meta — un 4xx puo lasciare la fattura draft orfana in DB anche dopo un errore. Solo wrappando il create con verify-after-error possiamo garantire idempotenza unattended.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Indispensabile per workflow agentici: senza phantom protection una retry naive crea duplicati su un'API fiscalmente vincolante.

novel_features.name: Web UI deep-link
novel_features.description: Restituisce l'URL canonico della SPA per qualsiasi fattura. Output URL nudo per default, JSON con --json/--agent.
novel_features.rationale: La SPA non espone un endpoint che restituisca l'URL human-friendly; l'URL deve essere costruito client-side. Avere un comando dedicato evita string-templating duplicato in script.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agenti che mostrano una draft a un umano per approvazione passano dall'URL: uno stato (creato) e poi un link per il visual review.

novel_features.name: PDF proforma offline
novel_features.description: Scarica il PDF identico al bottone 'Scarica PDF' della SPA usando il renderer jsPDF embedded nella CLI. --no-footer per togliere il watermark partitaiva24, --launch per aprirlo subito.
novel_features.rationale: Il PDF e generato 100% client-side dalla SPA via jsPDF: nessun endpoint REST lo serve. Senza questo comando l'unico modo e cliccare nel browser; gli agenti non possono.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Chiude il cerchio del workflow agentico: create draft, download proforma, review, transmit. Tutto da CLI senza intervento umano sul browser.

novel_features.name: WordPress cookie + nonce auth
novel_features.description: Salva cookie p24_logged_in_<hash> e header X-WP-Nonce in config TOML. Il nonce ruota ogni ~24h: refresh con auth set --nonce <new>.
novel_features.rationale: WordPress REST richiede cookie + nonce su ogni call autenticata. Il nonce e separato dal cookie e ha lifetime piu corta. Senza un comando dedicato, l'agente deve toccare manualmente il config.toml.
novel_features.why_it_matters: L'unico comando che NON esponiamo come MCP tool (mcp:hidden) per principio: gli agenti non devono mai leggere/scrivere credenziali dell'utente.

narrative.headline: Every Partitaiva24 endpoint as a typed CLI command, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers the questions the web UI doesn't — turnover countdown, quarterly tax projection, AR aging, SDI status sweep.
narrative.value_prop: Partitaiva24 ships a complete REST namespace at /api/v1/ but no SDK and no docs. This CLI mirrors the full surface — invoices, income invoices, customers, F24, corrispettivi, esterometro, docs, attachments, subscriptions — into a local store, then layers offline analytics most freelancers reach for monthly: forfettario turnover meter, quarterly IVA/IRPEF/INPS projection, customer concentration, VIES batch validation, F24 iCal export, and a portable backup the platform doesn't offer.
narrative.auth_narrative: Partitaiva24's API is gated by the same WordPress session your browser uses: the `p24_logged_in_<hash>` cookie plus an `X-WP-Nonce` header. After logging in to the web app, copy both values from any logged-in page (DevTools → Network → any /api/v1/ request) and run `auth set --cookie '<full-cookie>' --nonce '<nonce>'`. Nonces rotate roughly every 24 hours; when calls start returning `rest_cookie_invalid_nonce`, run `auth set --nonce <new-nonce>` to refresh just the nonce. The cookie itself lasts longer (until you sign out of the browser).

quickstart.command: partitaiva24-pp-cli auth set --cookie '<paste full Cookie header>' --nonce '<paste X-WP-Nonce>'
quickstart.comment: Capture the WordPress session and nonce from your browser DevTools.
Confirms the session is live and shows API version + system info.
Pulls invoices, income invoices, customers, F24, corrispettivi, docs, attachments, events into the local store.
Where you stand against the forfettario cap right now.
Unpaid invoices bucketed by days overdue.
Find transmissions that didn't come back from SDI.

troubleshoots.fix: Refresh the nonce: open any /api/v1/ XHR in DevTools, copy the X-WP-Nonce header, then run `auth set --nonce <new-nonce>`.
Cookie expired. Sign in to partitaiva24.cloud, copy the full Cookie header, then `auth set --cookie '<value>'`.

troubleshoots.symptom: Empty list on `invoices list` after sync succeeded
troubleshoots.fix: The user has no invoices for the requested fiscal year. Try `--year` with another year or `invoices stats` to confirm.
`sync` first — turnover reads invoices-stats live but joins against the synced fiscal_year row.

narrative.when_to_use: Pick this CLI when you (or your agent) need answers Partitaiva24's web UI fragments across multiple pages — quarterly tax projection, AR aging, customer concentration, SDI sweep — or when you need a portable backup of your invoicing data. Don't reach for it for one-off web actions like sending a single PDF; that's two clicks in the browser. The win is bulk operations and offline analytics over a synced local mirror.

recipes.explanation: After running `sync`, read the turnover meter — pair with `tax-due --quarter 2026-Q2` for the full monthly check-in.

recipes.explanation: Lists every invoice transmitted >7 days ago without an ack — narrow output to four columns so an agent can act on it cleanly.

recipes.explanation: Runs /tools/check-vies for each synced EU customer and emits a structured invalid/valid list.

recipes.title: Backup before switching commercialista
recipes.explanation: Full snapshot — SQLite + CSV + actual invoice PDFs — the portable copy the platform doesn't give you.

recipes.explanation: Three columns ready to paste into a meeting note.
